description: The Relations body of the modeling inspector: the selected element's outgoing and incoming relationships (relationship type plus the counterpart with its semantic-type icon) and, for a selected relationship, its source and target as navigable rows. Activations route through the editor's existing selection paths; the by-element relationship index is built once per Relationships reference.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: The selected modeling element; renders its outgoing/incoming relationship groups. Takes precedence when a relationship is supplied too.

parameters.name: Relationship
parameters.description: The selected modeling relationship; renders its source and target as navigable rows.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements used to resolve counterpart display names and semantic-type icons.

parameters.name: Relationships
parameters.description: The loaded model's relationships — the source of the memoized outgoing/incoming index (built once per collection reference).

parameters.name: OnElementSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user activates a counterpart (or a source/target row) to select that element.

parameters.name: OnRelationshipSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user activates a relationship type to select that relationship.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__group
cssClasses.description: One relationship group (Outgoing / Incoming / Source / Target) with its heading and rows.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__group-title
cssClasses.description: The group heading with the localized label and the count badge.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__count
cssClasses.description: Count badge inside a group heading (visible digits + sr-only plural).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__row
cssClasses.description: One relationship row (a li carrying the modeling-related-{direction}-{relationshipId} test id).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__nav
cssClasses.description: The counterpart / endpoint navigation button (static variant renders the Unknown fallback).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__type
cssClasses.description: The relationship-type action on an element row (trailing chip with the Link2 icon).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__icon
cssClasses.description: Semantic-type icon tile of a row action.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__text
cssClasses.description: Truncated display text of a row action.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-related__empty
cssClasses.description: The localized empty state shown without a selection or with no related relationships.
